steps.caption: Today's meetings are listed first. Open this one.
The brief: readiness score, purpose, attendees, history and questions to ask.
Press Meeting mode when the meeting starts.
One screen: who is here, what to ask, talking points.
Scroll for the questions to ask and talking points.
Type a note as it happens and Save.
Mark a promise as an Action item, then Save.
After the meeting: Finish turns the notes into updates.
Your notes are included. Press Structure my notes.
It found the size change and our commitment, each quoted from your notes.
Each box decides what happens: history, Review proposals, tasks, contact changes.
Choose what to apply — also tick 'Draft a follow-up email'.
Done: changes went to Review, tasks were created, and a follow-up draft waits in Outreach.
Open Review to approve the proposed changes.
